Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-polish-medium-0023-reverse-03", "row_sha256": "feeca24353dfeb6f0ab51f92643d68413959df9109e1d3d201b708bf7d33173a", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "the irrigation line for the west side of the orchard had a leak near the third row, and water was running across the track instead of reaching the trees. on tuesday morning, mara shut off the section valve and found a split coupling under the mulch. she said the pipe itself looked sound, so the repair was limited to that fitting. the first replacement coupling at the supply counter was the wrong size, and she took it back before buying the correct one. after the line was opened again, she watched the joint for several minutes and saw no water coming from it. the repair invoice lists the new coupling, two clamps, and the service visit. the final bill was $105.69, not $72.42. that lower figure was from an earlier estimate and was not what the orchard paid. the west-side line was running again by noon, while the other irrigation sections had remained on their usual schedule. mara left the old split coupling beside the pump shed so the orchard manager could see what had been replaced.", "output": "The irrigation line serving the west side of the orchard had a leak near the third row, and water was running across the track instead of reaching the trees. On Tuesday morning, Mara shut off the section valve and found a split coupling under the mulch. She said the pipe itself looked sound, so the repair was limited to that fitting. The first replacement coupling at the supply counter was the wrong size, and she returned it before buying the correct one. After the line was opened again, she watched the joint for several minutes and saw no water leaking from it. The repair invoice lists the new coupling, two clamps, and the service visit. The final bill was $105.69, not $72.42. That lower figure was from an earlier estimate and was not what the orchard paid. The west-side line was running again by noon, while the other irrigation sections had remained on their usual schedule. Mara left the old split coupling beside the pump shed so the orchard manager could see what had been replaced."}]
